title: Use an uploaded photorealistic character sheet as the exact identity reference…
content:
Use an uploaded photorealistic character sheet as the exact identity reference and explicitly instruct Seedance 2.0 to preserve facial structure, hairstyle, eye color, body proportions, costume, weapons, accessories, materials, and overall appearance perfectly in every frame (no redesign/simplification).

Structure your Seedance prompt into clear sections (SCENE, ACTION, CAMERA, LIGHTING, ATMOSPHERE, STYLE, DURATION, PRIORITY) to control environment, motion beats, cinematography, and constraints.

Specify detailed camera choreography (slow tracking from behind/left → smooth push-in to medium close-up on expression change → fluid lateral tracking during dash → over-the-shoulder from behind cover → slow push-in to intense eye close-up) to get seamless cinematic motion without cuts or shake.

Set DURATION to 15 seconds to match the intended action sequence timing.

Add realism directives like natural breathing, realistic eye movement, subtle hair/cloth motion, physically based rendering (PBR), physically accurate lighting, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, and premium color grading to push ultra-photoreal cinematic output.

Prioritize identity consistency explicitly as the highest priority to maintain identical facial features, costume, proportions, colors, and equipment across the entire video.

es.content:
Usa una hoja de personaje fotorrealista subida como referencia exacta de identidad e indica explícitamente a Seedance 2.0 que preserve perfectamente en cada fotograma la estructura facial, el peinado, el color de ojos, las proporciones corporales, el vestuario, las armas, los accesorios, los materiales y el aspecto general (sin rediseño ni simplificación).

Estructura tu prompt de Seedance en secciones claras (SCENE, ACTION, CAMERA, LIGHTING, ATMOSPHERE, STYLE, DURATION, PRIORITY) para controlar el entorno, los beats de movimiento, la cinematografía y las restricciones.

Especifica una coreografía de cámara detallada (slow tracking from behind/left → smooth push-in to medium close-up on expression change → fluid lateral tracking during dash → over-the-shoulder from behind cover → slow push-in to intense eye close-up) para lograr un movimiento cinematográfico fluido y sin cortes ni vibración.

Configura DURATION en 15 seconds para que coincida con el timing previsto de la secuencia de acción.

Añade directrices de realismo como natural breathing, realistic eye movement, subtle hair/cloth motion, physically based rendering (PBR), physically accurate lighting, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, HDR y premium color grading para potenciar una salida cinematográfica ultra fotorrealista.

Prioriza explícitamente la consistencia de identidad como la máxima prioridad para mantener idénticos los rasgos faciales, el vestuario, las proporciones, los colores y el equipamiento en todo el video.

fr.content:
Utilisez une character sheet photoréaliste importée comme référence d’identité exacte et demandez explicitement à Seedance 2.0 de préserver parfaitement, dans chaque frame, la structure du visage, la coiffure, la couleur des yeux, les proportions du corps, le costume, les armes, les accessoires, les matériaux et l’apparence générale (sans redesign ni simplification).

Structurez votre prompt Seedance en sections claires (SCENE, ACTION, CAMERA, LIGHTING, ATMOSPHERE, STYLE, DURATION, PRIORITY) afin de नियंत्रler l’environnement, les beats de mouvement, la cinématographie et les contraintes.

Précisez une chorégraphie de caméra détaillée (slow tracking from behind/left → smooth push-in to medium close-up on expression change → fluid lateral tracking during dash → over-the-shoulder from behind cover → slow push-in to intense eye close-up) pour obtenir un mouvement cinématographique fluide et sans coupure ni tremblement.

Réglez DURATION sur 15 seconds pour correspondre au timing de la séquence d’action prévue.

Ajoutez des directives de réalisme comme natural breathing, realistic eye movement, subtle hair/cloth motion, physically based rendering (PBR), physically accurate lighting, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, et premium color grading pour pousser un rendu ultra-photoréaliste et cinématographique.

Priorisez explicitement la cohérence d’identité comme priorité absolue afin de conserver des traits du visage, un costume, des proportions, des couleurs et un équipement identiques sur l’ensemble de la vidéo.

ja.content:
アップロードしたフォトリアルなキャラクターシートを、正確なアイデンティティ参照として使用し、Seedance 2.0 に対して、顔の構造、髪型、目の色、体のプロポーション、衣装、武器、アクセサリー、素材、そして全体的な外見を、すべてのフレームで完全に維持するよう明示的に指示する（再デザイン／簡略化はしない）。

Seedance の prompt は、環境、動きのビート、シネマトグラフィー、制約を制御できるよう、明確なセクション（SCENE、ACTION、CAMERA、LIGHTING、ATMOSPHERE、STYLE、DURATION、PRIORITY）に分けて構成する。

シームレスな cinematic motion をカットや揺れなしで実現するために、詳細な camera choreography（背後／左からのゆっくりした tracking → 表情の変化に合わせた滑らかな push-in で medium close-up → ダッシュ中の流れるような lateral tracking → 隠れ場所の後ろからの over-the-shoulder → 緊張感のある eye close-up へのゆっくりした push-in）を指定する。

DURATION は、意図したアクションシーケンスのタイミングに合わせて 15 seconds に設定する。

自然な呼吸、リアルな視線の動き、微細な髪や布の揺れ、physically based rendering（PBR）、物理的に正確な lighting、volumetric fog、shallow depth of field、HDR、プレミアムな color grading などのリアリズム指示を追加し、超フォトリアルな cinematic output を強化する。

ビデオ全体を通して顔の特徴、衣装、プロポーション、色、装備を完全に一致させるため、identity consistency を最優先事項として明示的に設定する。

ko.content:
업로드한 포토리얼리스틱 캐릭터 시트를 정확한 아이덴티티 레퍼런스로 사용하고, Seedance 2.0에 얼굴 구조, 헤어스타일, 눈 색, 신체 비율, 의상, 무기, 액세서리, 소재, 전체적인 외형을 모든 프레임에서 완벽하게 유지하도록 명시적으로 지시하세요(재디자인/단순화 없음).

Seedance prompt를 SCENE, ACTION, CAMERA, LIGHTING, ATMOSPHERE, STYLE, DURATION, PRIORITY의 명확한 섹션으로 구성해 환경, 동작 비트, 촬영, 제약 조건을 제어하세요.

상세한 카메라 동선을 지정하세요(뒤/왼쪽에서 느린 트래킹 → 표정 변화에 맞춰 부드럽게 미디엄 클로즈업으로 푸시인 → 돌진 중 유려한 측면 트래킹 → 엄폐물 뒤에서 오버 더 숄더 → 강렬한 눈 클로즈업으로 천천히 푸시인) ताकि 컷이나 흔들림 없이 매끄러운 시네마틱 모션을 얻을 수 있습니다.

DURATION을 15초로 설정해 의도한 액션 시퀀스의 타이밍과 맞추세요.

자연스러운 호흡, 사실적인 눈 움직임, 미세한 머리카락/의상 움직임, physically based rendering(PBR), 물리적으로 정확한 조명, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, HDR, 프리미엄 컬러 그레이딩 같은 사실감 지시를 추가해 ultra-photoreal cinematic 결과물을 끌어올리세요.

영상 전체에서 동일한 얼굴 특징, 의상, 비율, 색상, 장비를 유지할 수 있도록 아이덴티티 일관성을 가장 높은 우선순위로 명시적으로 지정하세요.

pt.content:
Use uma ficha de personagem fotorrealista enviada como referência exata de identidade e instrua explicitamente o Seedance 2.0 a preservar perfeitamente a estrutura facial, o penteado, a cor dos olhos, as proporções corporais, o figurino, as armas, os acessórios, os materiais e a aparência geral em cada frame (sem redesign/simplificação).

Estruture seu prompt do Seedance em seções claras (SCENE, ACTION, CAMERA, LIGHTING, ATMOSPHERE, STYLE, DURATION, PRIORITY) para controlar o ambiente, os beats de movimento, a cinematografia e as restrições.

Especifique uma coreografia de câmera detalhada (slow tracking from behind/left → smooth push-in to medium close-up on expression change → fluid lateral tracking during dash → over-the-shoulder from behind cover → slow push-in to intense eye close-up) para obter movimento cinematográfico contínuo e sem cortes ou tremores.

Defina DURATION como 15 seconds para corresponder ao timing pretendido da sequência de ação.

Adicione diretrizes de realismo como respiração natural, movimento realista dos olhos, movimento sutil de cabelo/tecido, physically based rendering (PBR), iluminação fisicamente precisa, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, HDR e premium color grading para elevar a saída cinematográfica ultra-fotorrealista.

Priorize explicitamente a consistência de identidade como a maior prioridade para manter idênticos os traços faciais, o figurino, as proporções, as cores e o equipamento ao longo de todo o vídeo.

zh.content:
使用上传的 photorealistic character sheet 作为精确的身份参考，并明确指示 Seedance 2.0 在每一帧中都要完美保留面部结构、发型、眼睛颜色、身体比例、服装、武器、配饰、材质以及整体外观（不要重新设计/简化）。

将你的 Seedance prompt 结构化为清晰的部分（SCENE、ACTION、CAMERA、LIGHTING、ATMOSPHERE、STYLE、DURATION、PRIORITY），以控制环境、动作节奏、镜头语言和约束条件。

指定详细的 camera choreography（slow tracking from behind/left → smooth push-in to medium close-up on expression change → fluid lateral tracking during dash → over-the-shoulder from behind cover → slow push-in to intense eye close-up），以获得无缝的 cinematic motion，避免切镜或抖动。

将 DURATION 设为 15 seconds，以匹配预期的动作序列时长。

加入 realism 指令，例如 natural breathing、realistic eye movement、subtle hair/cloth motion、physically based rendering (PBR)、physically accurate lighting、volumetric fog、shallow depth of field、HDR 和 premium color grading，以推动 ultra-photoreal cinematic 输出。

将 identity consistency 明确设为最高优先级，以在整个视频中保持完全一致的面部特征、服装、比例、颜色和装备。
